ui_ctrl_move_desc: Walk left or right with responsive physics
ui_ctrl_jump_desc: Agile jump with variable height and squash & stretch
ui_ctrl_shoot_desc: Tap to fire or hold to charge up to 4 devastating plasma levels
ui_ctrl_vertical_desc: Hold Up or Down while shooting to fire vertically
ui_ctrl_dash_desc: Supersonic horizontal dash to cross gaps and dodge hazards
ui_ctrl_edash_desc: At max charge, dash shatters ruby/emerald crystals and damages bosses
ui_ctrl_slash_desc: Close-range frontal melee slash in the Dark Hallway
ui_touch_dpad_desc: 8-direction virtual pad to run and aim up or down
ui_touch_jump_desc: Tap to jump. Slide smoothly toward shoot without lifting your finger
ui_touch_shoot_desc: Tap to shoot a star or hold to charge your energy orb
ui_touch_dash_desc: Quick burst in the direction Peggy is facing
ui_touch_edash_desc: Appears next to the D-Pad at Level 4 charge to smash obstacles
ui_touch_slash_desc: Replaces action buttons during the dark hunt for melee cuts
ui_credits_engine_desc: Crafted 100% with Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas 2D & GSAP. Pure fun without bulky frameworks!
